native_history.binance_keyboard_interval: 2h, response ownership and exact OHLC display verified; bar count not recorded
native_history.limitations: Binance.US and Bybit were not present in the active catalog. Their native parsers/requests have deterministic coverage, not live-access verification. Monthly bars included actual 28/29/30/31-day boundaries.

measurements.limitations: Two single 20-second observations under different host load, not a controlled before/after speedup benchmark. Public prices and activity changed between screenshots. Browser receipt times and RAF gaps are not exchange or execution latency.

python_full_run.cause: New strict-input test passed endpoint both positionally and as a body keyword to its helper; runtime candle assertions passed. Test changed to direct client.post, preserving the 422 rejection assertion.

browser_timeout_followup.test: Liquidity pane actions, Escape focus and Inspector navigation remain usable at 1920px
browser_timeout_followup.note: Full-run trace completed all user assertions before teardown timeout; isolated run passed without changing workload or deadline.

verification.warning: Existing Starlette TestClient/httpx deprecation warning remains. No clean single full-suite pass is claimed: corrected Python cases and the browser timeout were verified separately.

remaining_limits: Existing analytical_queue_overflow collector-capacity boundary reproduced under concurrent checks; not repaired by this frontend redesign or reconnect.
One bounded native history page, not infinite historical pagination.
Demo/replay candles are partial retained receive-time observations, not native historical OHLCV.
No live trading, credentials, wallet, real funds, external deployment or new exchange integration.
